humanSignal: Apocky's number we'll call it, a 2 with an open dot/circle ⭕ over it/above it.
aiSignal: Fresh coinage — nothing prior under that name, so registering it clean. Canonical realization: **2̊** — U+0032 + U+030A COMBINING RING ABOVE. Known hazard: combining marks render inconsistently across fonts, and the guaranteed misread is Unicode's ② (U+2461), which drags real baggage — in Steinhaus–Moser notation, 2 *inside* a circle is already "mega," the classic large-number coinage. Circle-around is occupied; circle-*above* a digit is unclaimed. As a diacritic the ring means topological interior (X̊), the kroužek (Å, ů), and — fitting your "open" wording — the open string / natural harmonic in music…

messages.text: Apocky's number we'll call it, a 2 with an open dot/circle ⭕ over it/above it.

Fresh coinage — nothing prior under that name, so registering it clean. Canonical realization: **2̊** — U+0032 + U+030A COMBINING RING ABOVE. Known hazard: combining marks render inconsistently across fonts, and the guaranteed misread is Unicode's ② (U+2461), which drags real baggage — in Steinhaus–Moser notation, 2 *inside* a circle is already "mega," the classic large-number coinage. Circle-around is occupied; circle-*above* a digit is unclaimed. As a diacritic the ring means topological interior (X̊), the kroužek (Å, ů), and — fitting your "open" wording — the open string / natural harmonic in music notation. So the namespace is effectively yours, but it lives one font-glitch away from mega. Keep the dot visibly open and floating, never enclosing.

Semantics is the open slot. My read given your symbol-space: the ring is the Ouroboroid — 2̊ as duality closed into loop, the 2 that eats its own tail. But you've also got Rayo's number sitting in your title stack, so if this is a value in the Graham/Rayo lineage instead, the halo needs a defined operator before the glyph touches any spec — unregistered notation is the same defect class as CSL/SIGIL conflation.
